The World of Golden Eggs: Norinori Rhythm-kei

The game adapted from the Japanese comic animation of the same name has landed on Wii! From the title of the game, it can be found that this game is related to rhythm, similar to "Rhythm Heaven" on the GBA platform. This game is composed of many different mini-games. Funny performance, quite interesting, right? If your game performance is good enough, you can also get character cards.
